title: kp signal
description: Planetary K-index (geomagnetic activity) from NOAA SWPC, 3-hourly values, fetched hourly. GET /api/signals/kp, polled every 30 min; 404 unless providers.kp.enabled (opt-in network); null until the first fetch. Not sensitive.

rows.description: The last 24 values (3 days), oldest first, each a [time, kp] pair.

at.description: When it was fetched. Unix time in seconds (float).
